purpose: Freeze semantic/structural regression expectations before M2 implementation tuning; avoid moving the test target or coupling to serialization/IDs.

assertions.description: Ato I and Cena I are reconstructed as distinct logical divisions rather than page artifacts.
Participant declaration, SpeakerCue, Speech and Character remain distinct; SpeakerCue is sibling of Speech, not its child/field.
VerseLine units are addressable and preserve source order/lineation.
Physical page end does not close an open speech merely because the page ends.
Source-derived units remain traceable to the source page/evidence.
Open structural state survives page/chunk boundaries and reconciles cross-page speech continuity.
Scene transitions are represented without fabricating entry/exit events not explicit in the edition.
Declared participant state remains distinct from inferred semantic transitions.
Page boundary is not promoted to logical document boundary.
Running header/folio are identified as recurrent physical/editorial material, not duplicate logical chapters.
Listing editorial container remains distinct from CodeBlock and TerminalTranscript content nature.
Terminal transcript and Bash source code are reconstructed as different structures.
Typography/layout remain available as evidence without a universal bold/monospace semantic shortcut.
Local literal-sensitive content can carry stricter fidelity than surrounding textual prose.
Table topology preserves rows, columns and cell membership rather than flattening to plain text.
Surface lexeme such as 011 is preserved independently from typed/normalized interpretation.
Editorial callout marker interleaved with terminal-like content remains distinguishable from program output.
Cross-page section continuity is preserved.
Multi-column physical layout is separated from logical reading order.
Paragraph continuity may cross columns/pages and remain one logical unit.
Footnote marker and footnote body are separate units connected by explicit relation.
Layout-caused dehyphenation/reconstruction preserves source evidence and derivation.
External scripture/bibliographic references remain external targets rather than copied canonical content.
Narrative utterance does not require theatrical SpeakerCue; speaker may be relation/inference or remain unknown.
Semantic function spanning a whole block can be a DocumentNode role; inline occurrence can be Annotation/span without structural inflation.
Narrative order remains document order; flashback/story chronology is not substituted for source order.
Scene break, embedded song/verse and internal thought are representable without new universal primitives.
EN and PT-BR manifestations remain distinct sources; translation alignment is not silently merged.
Mathematical visual/glyph/layout evidence is retained even when PDF text layer is plausible but semantically corrupt.
FormulaPayload distinguishes source representation from reconstructed representation with provenance.
Inline formula nodes and text fragments can participate in one shared logical order.
Figure panels are individually addressable/anchorable.
Pedagogical structures such as Definition/Example/Solution/Exercise use roles/relations without new universal core primitives.
A page may begin mid-speech with open structural state and no fabricated local speaker.
SpeakerCue and Speech remain sibling structures connected semantically.
Scene VI and participant declaration are represented explicitly without inferred stage events.
VerseLine ordering/identity survives the page boundary.
Running header/folio do not duplicate logical chapter and paragraph continuation is preserved.
Listing may contain terminal interaction plus editorial omission marker without flattening.
Typography can support input-vs-echo reconstruction without becoming a universal semantic rule.
Roles technical.terminal_input and editorial.omission_marker are accepted extensions under CBM v0.1.
Editorial note and external URL remain source editorial/reference content, distinct from generated assistance.
